# IncreasedWithdrawalScenario（seed 5）

## 背景

This is the number of cash withdrawals from an automated teller machine (ATM) in an arbitrary location in England.

## 情景

Suppose that there is a festival from 1996-11-12 00:00:00, for 4 days leading to more people in the area, and 3 times the number of usual withdrawals during that period.

## 约束

无

## 季节周期

7
